title: Snow guns
notes: Right after the cold phase of shot 10 (-8 C, then precipitation 0 so the falling snow clears). Normalized date 0.871, sim clock about 14:20, Time of Day 15.9 to 16.1. The storyboard place (3255, -2476) looked through a fir belt: the near guns' plumes were behind trunks. This path stands on the open run east of the belt, 5 m above the snow (ground 1129.1 at the start, 1127.7 at the end), and looks east-southeast at the alpenglow peak: a lit plume left of the peak, a second one right of it, the moon at the upper left, firs passing in the left foreground. A lateral dolly of 12.6 m (a longer one runs into a fir at either end: stills b11-e2 and b11-i). Plume leases live during the take: 37 of 44 (EarlyDisasterWarningDuration.m_EndFrame above the sim frame). Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60), sim speed 1.
